svg.style: background: #eef2f6; background-color: light-dark(#eef2f6, #1b1e21); color-scheme: light dark;

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(219, 227, 236), rgb(37, 44, 52));

g.text: R U R' U R U2 R'
R U2 R' U' R U' R'
R U' R U R U R U' R' U' R2
Cycle three edges while keeping the corners
R = right U = up ' = inverse 2 = half turn
